choreography.somatic_posture: Relaxed grounded stance with palm facing forward at solar plexus level

sensory_expression.visual_form: Spherical warm amber glow hovering 5cm above the palm; soft diffuse boundary with no sharp edges
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Gentle low harmonic hum at ~120 Hz
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Subtle radiant warmth across the skin of the hand
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Diffuse soft falloff (gamma 2.2); luminance capped at 250 nits to preserve skin texture and epidermal micro-contrast

failure.breakdown_visual: Gentle amber dissipation into warm air currents

choreography.somatic_posture: Firm two-handed grip on lamp collar; deliberate thumb actuation of shutter dial

sensory_expression.visual_form: Conical beam refracted through dual-lens collimator; sharp geometric edge with angular aperture cutoff
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Sharp metallic shutter click followed by quiet 1kHz ballast hiss
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Rhythmic mechanical detents through fingertips; brass chassis vibration
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Directional forward projection away from face; rear reflection shielded so operator complexion remains clearly readable

choreography.somatic_posture: Neutral upright alignment; hands cupped at lower abdomen; spine lengthened

sensory_expression.visual_form: Faint violet aura clinging to silhouetted contours of the torso; thin interference fringes
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Skin goosebumps (piloerection) and gentle tingling along spinal meridian
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Deep non-saturating violet fringe; negative shadow contrast highlights rich melanin undertones without washing out facial planes

failure.breakdown_visual: Inaudible collapse of the violet aura toward the navel center

choreography.somatic_posture: Dynamic side stance; leading arm arcs fluidly overhead while trailing arm stabilizes
choreography.rhythm: Sustained legato tempo with elastic velocity curves

sensory_expression.visual_form: Braided magenta luminous filament curling dynamically in 3D curves around the arm's Aetherwear conduit sleeve
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Resonant vocalic soprano shimmer at ~880 Hz
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Warm inductive magnetic drag against the forearm textile fibers
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Filament radius constrained to 12mm; local bloom bounded to 350 nits so forearm and facial skin tones remain deep, rich, and detailed

failure.breakdown_visual: Filament unravels into dispersed magenta sparkles that fade within 0.2s
failure.somatic_recoil: Sudden drop in magnetic tension causing forearm rebound

choreography.somatic_posture: High braced carry; thumbs operating binary selector keys on lamp body
choreography.rhythm: Syncopated digital bursts with microsecond dwell times

sensory_expression.visual_form: Sharp rectangular light pulses with 90-degree orthogonal raster traces in bright cyan
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: High-pitched clock pulses at 2.4 kHz with rhythmic micro-clicks
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Haptic pulse click on the casing for every byte frame transmitted
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: High-contrast rim lighting; cyan photons projected forward through polarized slit, leaving operator face warmly lit by ambient backscatter

failure.breakdown_visual: Abrupt clock desynchronization; cyan trace flickers and drops to dark in 1 frame
failure.somatic_recoil: Sharp tactile disconnect on the selector switches

choreography.somatic_posture: Still head alignment; pupils widen slightly; eyes track along environmental fault lines
choreography.rhythm: Fixed continuous dilation and steady gaze

sensory_expression.visual_form: Concentric luminous rings in the iris; lemon-lime particle flashes marking boundary gradients on surfaces
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Phase-shifted binaural shimmer (~220 Hz difference tone)
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Cool sensation around the eye sockets and bridge of nose
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Glow is internal to iris and pupil; exterior facial surfaces receive zero washing, highlighting sculptural bone structure

failure.breakdown_visual: Concentric rings collapse inward to the pupil with a momentary afterimage
failure.somatic_recoil: Transient eye fatigue and brief tearing

choreography.somatic_posture: Wide dynamic stance; right hand sweeps the lamp in an elliptical orbit while left arm routes the Aetherwear conduit into the intake aperture
choreography.rhythm: Polyrhythmic: continuous 3/4 wave glide in the right arm coupled with syncopated 4/4 shutter pulses in the left fingers

sensory_expression.visual_form: A double-helix light beacon: an undulating continuous magenta wave (sorcery carrier) braided tightly with an orthogonal, sharply stepped cyan zigzag lattice (addressed signal). The intersection nodes flash with brief white-violet coherence spikes.
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Harmonic acoustic signature: a sustained 440 Hz rich cello-like resonance layered with crisp rhythmic 2.4 kHz high-frequency clock pulses
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Balanced counter-torque across both hands: the lamp feels gyro-stabilized, resisting lateral motion as the beam locks into alignment
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Dual complementary rim light: magenta rims the right cheekbone, cyan rims the left cheekbone, leaving deep, unblown, natural melanin tone down the center of the face with maximum textural fidelity

failure.breakdown_visual: Dissolve Lattice: The cyan zigzag lattice snaps instantly; unsupported magenta wave oscillates violently into turbulent ribbons and dissipates into harmless atmospheric heat
failure.somatic_recoil: Sudden loss of gyroscopic resistance causes the lamp to drop heavily in the hands; minor static prickle on fingertips

choreography.somatic_posture: Full-body circular movement; torso rotating around stationary center axis; lamp held high in right hand, left fingers articulating Aetherwear resonant threads
choreography.rhythm: Tripartite interlocking tempo: continuous wave base, syncopated digital clock, and slow undulating breath pulse

sensory_expression.visual_form: An intricate three-dimensional reality lattice: magenta wave filaments, cyan zigzag routing bars, and threshold UV liminal membranes intertwine to form a temporary architectural light mechanism. Amber grounding pulses emanate from the base.
sensory_expression.auditory_frequency: Full-spectrum chordal choir hum with polyrhythmic digital clicks and deep spatial reverberation
sensory_expression.tactile_feedback: Weightless sensation throughout the limbs coupled with tingling electrical charge across the scalp and collarbone
sensory_expression.skin_tone_protection_rule: Atmospheric volumetric lighting with inverse-square falloff; high dynamic range (HDR) tonemapped to prevent facial clipping; deep rich skin tones remain the central visual anchor of the composition

failure.breakdown_visual: Cascade Coherence Failure: The threshold membranes shatter into micro-particles; zigzag lattice disintegrates in sequence; amber grounding pulses arc safely to floor surfaces
failure.somatic_recoil: Instantaneous gravitational re-anchoring; performer must catch their footing; residual static hum along the conduit sleeve
